import json,hashlib
from PIL import Image,ImageStat
P=Path('docs/handoffs/codex_flat_vector_art_2026-10-07/r29_startup_ambience_context')
expected=['normal_startup','continuous_2s','idle_00','idle_25','idle_50','idle_75','idle_settled','background_touch_released']
rows=[]
for f in sorted((P/'native').glob('*/capture_manifest.json')):
 d=json.loads(f.read_text());e=d['engine'];assert [e['major'],e['minor'],e['patch'],e['status'],e['build'],e['hash']]==[4,7,2,'stable','official','ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079']
 assert d['rendering_method']=='mobile' and d['display_server']!='headless' and d['quality']=='speedy' and not d['errors'] and not d['teardown_main_valid']
 assert d['normal_save_before']==d['normal_save_after']==d['normal_save_after_teardown'] and len(d['normal_save_before'])==8
 assert [x['id'] for x in d['states']]==expected and len(d['catalogue'])==100
 assert '/profiles/startup/' in d['private_profile_path'].replace('\\','/')
 previous=-1.0
 for x in d['states']:
  assert x['elapsed_seconds']>previous;previous=x['elapsed_seconds'];pres=x['presentation']
  assert pres['start_menu_active'] and pres['start_menu_layer_present'] and pres['intro_active'] and not pres['intro_overlay_present'] and not pres['boot_splash_present'] and pres['fade_alpha']<=.02
  assert x['active_stage']==x['resolved_stage']=='intro.storybook' and x['layer_visible'] and x['canvas_visible'] and x['layer_index']==21 and not x['suspended'] and x['quiet_group_nodes']==0 and x['probe_stage_override']=='' and x['quality']=='speedy'
  assert x['background']['visible'] and x['background']['texture']=='res://assets/ui/boot_splash_mermaid_roshan.png' and x['background']['texture_sha256']=='d5127c4a6227baab05343dc10692e2f76f1dd59f22ca24a22329de402dbb8044'

  q=f.parent/x['image']['file'];b=q.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==x['image']['sha256'] and len(b)==x['image']['bytes']
  im=Image.open(q).convert('RGB');assert list(im.size)==d['aspect']==x['image']['dimensions'] and min(ImageStat.Stat(im).stddev)>20;rows.append(x['image']['sha256'])
 for i,p in enumerate([0,.25,.5,.75]):
  x=d['states'][i+2];assert p<=x['canvas_event_progress']<p+.04 and x['event_count']==1
 assert d['states'][2]['idle_time']>=22 and d['states'][0]['event_count']==0 and d['states'][6]['canvas_event_progress']==-1 and d['states'][-1]['event_count']==1 and d['states'][-1]['idle_time']<.3
